intuition: A right rotation moves the final k nodes to the front, which can be done by temporarily making the list circular.

brute_force.approach: Move the tail to the head one step at a time k times.

optimal.approach: Find the length and tail, link tail to head, then break the ring at the new tail after reducing k modulo length.

edge_cases: An empty or one-node list is unchanged.
A rotation by a multiple of list length changes nothing.
The new tail is length-k nodes from the original tail.
